Reference to classification of cash transactions
Ex. General Fund, State Highway Fund; References money set aside for a particular purpose
Ex. 1000; References money set aside for a particular purpose
Ex. Legal_Fund; Identifies the legal fund associated with the operating fund
Ex. Access Indiana; References operating funds under legal fund
Ex. 46710; References operating funds under a legal fund

References the fiscal year period to which the balance belongs.
0 = Beginning Balance Period
1 = July
2 = August
3 = September
4 = October
5 = November
6 = December
7 = January
8 = February
9 = March
The state operates on a fiscal year beginning July 1 and ending June 30.
